title: Surface rate limits on the dashboard

steps.text: Looking at how the fleet summary should surface a rate limit to an operator.
There are two reasonable designs here and I don't want to guess wrong on the one that's user-facing.

questions.question: How should a rate limit show up in the summary?

options.label: Inline suffix
options.description: append "- rate limited (retry in Ns)" to the existing summary line

options.label: Separate banner
options.description: a distinct warning line above the summary

questions.question: Should the retry countdown be shown?

options.label: Yes
options.description: show the seconds remaining until retry

steps.text: Got it - an inline suffix with the countdown. Wiring that up now.

input.description: add an optional rate-limit suffix to summarize()

steps.text: Done - the summary now reads "...- rate limited (retry in 12s)" when the fleet is throttled.
